jobs.title: Director, Advisory Services - Payer Strategy and Management Consulting - Remote
jobs.description:
Optum Insight is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us to start  Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Director, Advisory Services has overall responsibility and authority across high-complexity, multi-workstream strategy and management consulting engagements serving payer clients and oversees engagement managers and project teams. The Director has overall responsibility to own, coordinate, and harmonize the overall project approach and final deliverable quality - ensuring cohesive analysis, evaluation, and compelling recommendations are aligned to the client's unique business situation and needs. The Director must possess relevant strategy, management consulting, and healthcare industry and payer knowledge to serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite payer client executives.  The Director must be able to help clients identify strategic priorities, improve financial and market performance, rationalize services, improve customer experiences, and address their specific business challenges.  The Director serves as a key point of contact with the seniormost clients with client delivery and is expected to be a driving force with new lead generation and end-to-end business development efforts with new and existing payer client executives.  The Director plays a critical role in team member mentorship and professional development, practice development, and strategic thought leadership.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities:
- Overall project lead across high-complexity, multi-workstream strategy and transformation focused consulting engagements for payer clients
- Build consensus among senior client stakeholders who play a critical role in the client's ability to successfully implement the identified solutions
- Oversees the day-to-day engagement manager(s) of projects and sets direction for development of key deliverables
- Serve as a subject matter expert in one or more areas (e.g., health plan operations, enterprise strategy, organizational redesign and transformation, AI enablement, GTM approaches, product strategy, administrative cost management, and life sciences)
- Provide subject matter expertise to other Optum Advisory and Optum/UnitedHealth Group Company business units as it relates to strategy development and addressing client issues
- Key point of contact for the most senior project client executive and helps establish optimal communication cadence with C-Suite executives
- Critical role in developing project team manager and direct reports to expand their core consulting skills
- Accountable for budget. Focuses on project economics and directs team to follow practices needed to ensure both quality and profitability including close monitoring of actual vs. expected team utilization
- Accountable for meeting delivery timelines
- Communicate effectively and accurately in writing and verbally to prospects, clients, and other staff
- Demonstrate strong client relationship management skills, ability to handle challenging interpersonal situations, and executive presence
- Drive and contribute to end-to-end business development efforts - both extensions of existing work as well as new business. Lead writing of proposals to prospect for additional work either with existing clients or greenfield ones.  Create and generate new leads.
- Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, generative AI platforms, AI-driven analytics) as part of day-to-day delivery and team workflow; model AI-first behaviors for the broader practice
- Manage and grow a book of business, cultivating long-term relationships with senior payer client buyers to drive sustained sales and revenue growth
- Contribute to internal practice initiatives including shaping product / offering development and strategic thought leadership beyond client project work

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.
Required Qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in management consulting (McKinsey-BCG-Bain / Big 4 / Boutique)
- 4+ years of experience in strategy and/or healthcare consulting
- 4+ years of experience with project management, developing and presenting deliverables to C-suite executives
- 4+ years of experience leading strategy work and/or strategic initiatives
- 2+ years of experience building, developing, and managing high-performing strategy consulting teams leveraging AI; ability to coach managers and senior consultants to create delivery leverage
- 2+ years of business development experience and success selling in the payer and life sciences commercial (for-profit and non-profit) market generating at least $1M+ annually in new sales
- Demonstrated familiarity with variety of problem-solving approaches
- Proficiency in MS Office Suite - Word, PowerPoint, Excel
- Demonstrated proficiency in AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, AI-driven analytics platforms) to drive day-to-day delivery and team workflows
- Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaborate effectively in team settings
- Demonstrated ability to drill down to the root cause of issues and be creative in problem solving
- Proven solid written and verbal communication skills
- Willing or ability to travel domestically, up to 50% when required

Preferred Qualifications:
- 10+ years of professional experience preferably in healthcare
- Experience working in and successfully navigating a matrixed environment
- Experience or subject matter expertise in: Health plan operations, organizational redesign and transformation, administrative cost management, growth and market entry strategy, AI enablement, and/or life sciences
- Experience successfully driving end-to-end sales and business development life cycle in a consulting environment (e.g., lead generation, proposal development, RFP response)
- Hands-on experience designing or deploying agentic AI tools or automation solutions within a consulting or operational context
- Background in healthcare consulting and ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams within a consulting project environment
- Demonstrated active network of senior buyer relationships within U.S. health plans (inclusive of any of the following: national, regional, mission-driven non-profit, or for-profit)

*All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $134,600 to $230,800 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

- 2+ years of experience tracking and planning projects, working with large data sets, and making data-driven analytical decisions
- Intermediate to advanced proficiency in MS Project, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and SharePoint
- Demonstrated ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and concisely and facilitate cross-functional meetings

The Technical Product Owner is responsible for the day‑to‑day product ownership and delivery of key enterprise Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platforms, including eGRC (RSA Archer), Aravo, Compliance Hub, and supporting GRC tools.

- Ensure production stability by managing defects, prioritizing fixes, and supporting platform enhancements

- Partner with vendors to track roadmap items, manage enhancements, and resolve platform issues

Operational Excellence:
- Track and report on platform KPIs, including adoption, stability, backlog health, and delivery throughput
- Support audit readiness and regulator‑facing needs by ensuring accurate, reliable system outputs

Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve user experience, and standardize processes across GRC platforms.

- 2+ years of demonstrated ability to translate risk, compliance, or audit requirements into documented technical requirements, including user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria

jobs.description:

Do you enjoy building functions, shaping strategy and driving value across complex supplier landscapes? If so, we'd love you to read on.

About the Team:

Our procurement team is undergoing an exciting transformation as we strengthen and scale our capability to support the business. Procurement plays a critical role in supporting Optum UK's commercial outcomes, supplier strategy, and operational efficiency.

This is a unique opportunity to join at a pivotal moment as we re-establish a best-in-class procurement function aligned to our growing, technology-led business.

This role is hybrid working; you will work predominantly from home and once a week in our Fulford Grange office (LS19 6BA).

About the Role:

As Procurement Director, you will take ownership of rebuilding and leading our procurement function, shaping strategy, governance and supplier management practices across the organisation.

You will play a key role in supporting the business through a period of transition, leading high-value supplier negotiations and ensuring robust procurement processes are in place to support growth, cost optimisation and risk management.

You will partner with senior stakeholders across Technology, Finance, Legal and Operations to deliver commercial value and drive long-term supplier performance.

Key Responsibilities:

- Define and implement a procurement strategy aligned to business priorities, growth plans and cost optimisation objectives

- Lead and develop a high-performing procurement team

- Lead complex, high-value negotiations with key technology and SaaS vendors (e.g. cloud providers, software suppliers)

- Establish and embed procurement governance, policies and best practice across the business

- Drive supplier relationship management, performance monitoring and risk mitigation

- Identify and deliver cost-saving opportunities across technology and operational spend

- Partner senior stakeholders across the organisation to influence commercial outcomes and decision-making

- Lead supplier transition activity and support business readiness across evolving commercial agreements and supplier arrangements.

Who You Are:

You are a commercially astute procurement leader with strong experience operating within a technology-led or complex organisation. You bring a strategic mindset but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves in a hands-on environment.

You thrive in transformation settings and enjoy building capability, driving change and delivering measurable value. Your ability to influence at senior level and navigate complex supplier landscapes will be key to your success in this role.

Key Skills, Experience & Qualifications

- Strong experience managing technology procurement, including SaaS, cloud and IT services

- Proven track record of leading complex commercial negotiations and delivering cost savings

- Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing senior leaders

- Experience building or transforming procurement functions and operating models

- Sound understanding of contract management, supplier risk and governance frameworks

Ready to Join Us?

At Optum, we are a UK leader in integrated healthcare software and services, supporting healthcare professionals across primary and community care, pharmacy, secondary care and specialist services. Our technology enables better, faster and more efficient patient care across the UK healthcare system. Apply today to take the next step in your career and make a tangible impact in UK healthcare.

- Prioritize and manage tasks effectively during periods of increased operational tempo or global activity
- Escalate issues that fall outside defined procedures or risk thresholds to senior operators or leadership as required

- Demonstrated ability to follow established processes while applying judgment within defined guidelines
- Proven solid written and verbal communication skills suited to operational environments
- Proven high attention to detail and accuracy when handling time‑sensitive or safety‑related information
- Proven ability to work effectively in a shift‑based, fast‑paced operational setting

jobs.title: Product & Business Development Program (PBDP) Internship -Pipeline
jobs.description:
Internships at Optum. If you want an intern experience that will dramatically shape your career, consider a company that's dramatically shaping our entire health care system. Optum, part of the UnitedHealth Group family of companies, is a leading health services and innovation company dedicated to helping make the health system work better for everyone. With more than 94,000 people collaborating worldwide, Optum combines people, technology, data and action to improve the delivery, quality and efficiency of health care. Our internship opportunities provide a view of a rapidly evolving, incredibly challenging marketplace of ideas, products and services. Here, you'll work with some of the smartest people in the business on assignments that matter. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

If you're looking for an experience that combines meaningful work, skill development, and real-world impact, the Product & Business Development Program (PBDP) Internship offers an opportunity to contribute to how healthcare operates, scales, and improves.

The PBDP Internship is a 10-week, full-time summer internship designed for students interested in building foundational experience in:
- Business analysis
- Project execution
- Product support/product management
- Process improvement
- Data-informed decision-making

You'll work on real projects, partner across teams, and develop practical skills that translate directly into business roles.

Program Details
- 10-week, full-time summer internship (June-August)
- Locations: Eden Prairie, MN and San Antonio, TX
- Work model: 4 or 5 days a week in office- depending on placement
- Placement process: Interns review project opportunities and rank preferences prior to team alignment the placement process takes place in the spring semester.

Why PBDP
This program is designed to help you:
- Gain hands-on experience in real business environments
- Build skills across operations, product, and analysis
- Understand how organizations use data to make decisions
- Develop professionally through mentorship, training, and networking

What We're Looking For
We're looking for students who are:
- Curious, motivated, and eager to learn in a business environment
- Solid communicators who can work across teams
- Organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities
- Interested in solving business problems through analysis and execution
- Detail-oriented and willing to work in structured, execution-focused environments

What You'll Do
Across all roles, you will:
- Contribute to real business initiatives through research, analysis, and execution
- Support teams by organizing workstreams, tracking progress, and completing deliverables
- Analyze processes and identify opportunities for improvement
- Create reports, summaries, and presentations to communicate insights clearly
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (operations, product, analytics, technology)
- Build foundational skills in documentation, communication, and problem-solving

In this role, you will actively apply AI tools and techniques within your functional area to drive efficiency, insights, and innovation. You will design, develop and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex business challenges.

Primary Responsibilities:
- Apply AI tools to solve business problems within your domain
- Build and optimize prompts for analysis, reporting, and automation
- Integrate AI into workflows (e.g., reporting, dashboards, operations processes)
- Analyze data using AI-enabled tools and generate insights
- Collaborate with teams to identify opportunities for AI-driven improvements
- Ensure responsible and compliant use of AI solutions

What to Expect
PBDP is a placement-based internship program, meaning you'll be aligned to a specific team and project based on business need and your interests.
Depending on your placement, your experience will primarily align to one of the following:

Business Operations / Project Execution (Most Common)
- Support project coordination, timelines, and deliverables
- Build and maintain trackers, reports, and presentations
- Assist with stakeholder communication and meeting preparation
- Analyze workflows and recommend process improvements
- Develop documentation such as SOPs, summaries, and project materials
- Focus: execution, organization, and operational problem-solving

Product / UX / Digital Experience
- Support product teams with user insights and feedback
- Assist with requirements, user stories, and journey mapping
- Contribute to usability testing or research
- Help improve digital experiences and internal tools
- Focus: supporting how products are built and improved

Data / Analytics / Systems Support
- Support reporting, dashboards, and data-driven insights
- Assist with data validation, QA checks, and testing
- Work with tools like Excel, SQL, or BI platforms (in some roles)
- Help translate data into clear business insights

Important:
This program focuses on applying data to inform business decisions, operations, and reporting.

The individual will bring practical expertise in enterprise forecasting, variance analysis, financial planning, driver-based modeling, performance reporting, and executive decision support. The role requires the ability to understand how finance work is performed today, identify where AI and automation can materially improve speed, quality, controls, and insight, and help convert future-state designs into tangible AI-enabled solutions.

The Senior Director will operate in a cross-functional pod model, working side by side with data engineers, solution architects, forward deployed engineers, AI/ML resources, risk and controls partners, and business finance leaders. The person will not simply advise from the sidelines. They will be expected to lead hands-on blueprinting sessions, define use-case requirements, pressure-test data and control assumptions, validate prototype outputs, and ensure that AI systems are solving real finance problems in a way that is accurate, explainable, auditable, and adoptable.

The purpose of this role is to provide senior-level FP&A and forecasting expertise to Finance AI pods that are redesigning core finance processes and developing proof-of-concept AI systems. The Senior Director will help move Finance from periodic, manual, and fragmented forecasting and analysis processes toward more continuous, driver-based, data-enabled, and AI-supported decision intelligence.

The role will focus on three integrated mandates:
- Blueprint the current state. Understand and document existing FP&A and forecasting activities, including process flows, data inputs, handoffs, manual workarounds, estimation methods, controls, outputs, and decision points
- Design the future state. Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define how forecasting, variance analysis, scenario modeling, performance reporting, and decision support should operate when AI, data, controls, and human judgment are designed together from the beginning
- Develop and validate AI proof-of-concept systems. Translate finance requirements into clear prototype designs, partner with data and technology teams during development, validate outputs against business expectations, and help determine whether POCs should be killed, refined, scaled, or transitioned to the AI Factory for productization

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities:
Finance SME Leadership in Pod Delivery
- Serve as a senior Finance SME within cross-functional Finance AI pods focused on FP&A, forecasting, performance reporting, and decision intelligence
- Partner with pod leads, business finance leaders, data teams, solution architects, and engineering resources to define the business problem, target outcomes, scope, requirements, and success criteria for each POC
- Bring practical FP&A judgment to AI design decisions, ensuring prototypes reflect how finance leaders actually forecast, analyze, explain, and make decisions
- Act as the translator between finance users and technical teams, converting business needs into clear, testable requirements for AI-enabled workflows
- Help ensure pod work remains focused on high-value finance problems rather than disconnected technology experimentation

Current-State Blueprinting
- Lead structured blueprinting sessions with Finance, business, data, and technology stakeholders to map current-state forecasting and FP&A processes
- Document key process steps, business owners, data sources, systems, handoffs, manual workarounds, spreadsheet dependencies, control points, approvals, recurring pain points, and decision outputs
- Identify the root causes of inefficiency, including fragmented data, inconsistent definitions, duplicative reporting, manual variance analysis, delayed business driver inputs, and legacy planning practices
- Distinguish between work that is essential judgment, work that can be automated, work that can be redesigned, and work that should be eliminated
- Partner with Risk and Controls to identify current control dependencies and determine where future-state AI processes must preserve or strengthen auditability, traceability, and human review

Future-State Design and Agent-Ready Workflow Development
- Design future-state FP&A and forecasting workflows that incorporate AI agents, governed data products, certified business definitions, automated insight generation, and human-in-the-loop decision rights
- Help define how evergreen forecasting, driver-based forecasting, variance explanation, scenario planning, and executive insight generation should operate across business segments
- Convert process redesign concepts into agent-ready workflows with clear triggers, inputs, outputs, decision points, exception handling, validation requirements, and escalation paths
- Partner with Data and Technology teams to define required data products, semantic layers, model inputs, output expectations, source citations, lineage needs, and evaluation criteria
- Ensure future-state designs balance speed and automation with Finance's unique requirements for precision, controls, regulatory readiness, and confidence in financial outputs

AI POC Development and Validation
- Partner with engineering and data teams to develop POCs for AI-enabled forecasting, variance analysis, bridge narratives, management reporting, planning support, and decision intelligence
- Define practical test cases, expected outputs, comparison baselines, and acceptance criteria for AI-generated forecasts, insights, narratives, and recommendations
- Validate prototype outputs against known business results, finance logic, source data, and user expectations
- Identify hallucination risk, inconsistent logic, data gaps, control deficiencies, usability issues, and adoption barriers before POCs move toward scale
- Recommend whether POCs should proceed to additional testing, be refined, be redesigned, be paused, or be transitioned to the AI Factory for productization

FP&A and Forecasting Transformation
- Bring deep expertise in forecasting methods, planning cycles, driver-based modeling, variance analysis, business performance management, and senior executive reporting
- Help redesign forecasting processes to move from static cycle-based planning toward more continuous, signal-based, and business-driver-informed forecasting
- Support development of AI-enabled capabilities across medical trend forecasting, cash forecasting, P&L forecasting, segment forecasting, and performance analytics
- Work with business finance teams to identify where AI can improve speed of insight, forecast accuracy, scenario analysis, root-cause identification, and decision support
- Help define how forecasting outputs should be consumed by CFOs, segment leaders, business operators, Investor Relations, Treasury, and other stakeholders

Data, Controls, and Governance
- Partner with Data teams to assess data readiness, data quality, source system limitations, business driver availability, and semantic consistency
- Escalate data gaps that prevent reliable AI-enabled forecasting or financial analysis
- Partner with Risk, Controls, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Finance leadership to ensure future-state AI workflows are explainable, traceable, auditable, and appropriately governed
- Support design of human approval gates, output review standards, source documentation, model validation checkpoints, and ongoing monitoring routines
- Ensure AI-enabled workflows are built with appropriate consideration for SOX, financial reporting precision, regulatory expectations, and enterprise governance standards

Stakeholder Engagement and Adoption
- Build credibility with senior Finance and business leaders by demonstrating solid business judgment, practical finance experience, and command of forecasting and performance management
- Facilitate working sessions with business SMEs, Controllers, FP&A leaders, Technology, Data, and Risk partners
- Translate complex AI and data concepts into clear finance implications for senior stakeholders
- Support change management by helping finance users understand how redesigned workflows will improve speed, insight, quality, and capacity
- Capture adoption barriers, training needs, process changes, and role impacts as AI-enabled workflows are piloted and scaled

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field
- 12+ years of progressive finance experience, with significant depth in FP&A, forecasting, business performance management, or enterprise financial planning
- Demonstrated experience leading or materially contributing to forecasting, planning, variance analysis, management reporting, or decision support in a large, complex enterprise
- Proven solid understanding of driver-based forecasting, P&L analysis, business metrics, executive reporting, and financial planning processes
- Experience working across business, finance, technology, and data teams to deliver process improvement, automation, analytics, or transformation initiatives
- Ability to map complex current-state processes and translate them into simplified future-state operating models
- Proven solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate data quality, process gaps, business logic, and control implications
- Proven solid executive communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex issues, frame trade-offs, and make clear recommendations
- Ability to operate in ambiguity, influence without direct authority, and move work forward across a matrixed organization
- Proven high degree of ownership, urgency, judgment, and attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications:
- MBA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent advanced finance, accounting, or analytics credential
- Experience with AI, machine learning, automation, analytics products, data products, or digital finance transformation
- Experience with Oracle EPM, enterprise planning tools, data visualization platforms, financial data marts, Snowflake, Azure, or related enterprise data environments
- Experience designing or implementing driver-based forecasting, rolling forecasts, scenario modeling, or advanced business performance analytics
- Experience supporting finance transformation in a regulated environment with SOX, SEC reporting, audit, model governance, or other control considerations
- Familiarity with agentic AI concepts, LLM-enabled workflows, human-in-the-loop controls, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt evaluation, and AI output validation
- Experience working in a product-oriented or agile delivery model, including POCs, pilots, MVPs, product roadmaps, and adoption measurement

*All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). The salary for this role will range from $159,300 - $273,200 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

jobs.title: Director, Data Analytics & Applied AI Solutions
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

About the Role:
The Director, Data Analytics & Applied AI Solutions is a senior leadership role within Clinical Solutions Risk Adjustment & Quality, responsible for owning, building and scaling data, analytics, automation and applied AI capabilities. The successful candidate will lead a team of capable, technical data analysts. They will be responsible for rapidly accelerating the organization's ability to uncover business insight, manage data and support decisions. They will do this by proactively uncovering areas where applied AI can significantly improve the status quo. These applications include, but are not limited to, machine-learning, agentic production, semantic model design and LLM integration.

It is envisaged that the role will display a solid entrepreneurial spirit. A key expectation is moving opportunities beyond experimentation, identifying high-value AI/ML, automation and advanced analytics use cases, progressing proofs of concept into production, driving adoption and ensuring measurable operational, commercial, quality or productivity impact.

The Director will partner across business, operations, product, data science, engineering and technology teams to translate operational challenges into secure, scalable analytics and AI-enabled solutions, including coding agents, intelligent automation, predictive models, data mining, LLM-enabled voice/text query and advanced decision support. Requirements gathering, needs assessment, stakeholder management and consensus building will all be key skills.

This role suits a leader who combines operational understanding, product thinking and applied AI delivery experience, while building a high-performing and inclusive team culture.

Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Dublin office and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model.

Primary Responsibilities:
- Own the Data Operations roadmap for data, analytics, automation and applied AI, prioritising opportunities that improve performance, insight, productivity, quality and decision-making
- Proactively uncover opportunities for AI to augment and improve status quo analytics delivery
- Deliver AI/ML, predictive analytics, coding agents, automation, data mining and LLM-enabled solutions from idea or proof of concept through production, adoption, scaling and measurable impact
- Lead BI, reporting, analytics, data management and decision-support capabilities across Clinical Solutions Data Operations
- Build solid technical partnerships with engineering, technology, product and business teams, shaping solution direction, trade-offs and production readiness
- Define key metrics, reporting standards, dashboards, data quality controls and performance insights for reliable business information
- Lead, coach and develop a team of data and analytics specialists, fostering accountability, collaboration, innovation, inclusion and performance

You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in.
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Analytics, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
- Proven experience leading business intelligence, reporting, dashboarding, data quality, analytics delivery, and business performance teams
- Proven experience building AI, machine learning, automation, advanced analytics, or agentic solutions from proof of concept through production, adoption, scaling, and value realization
- Demonstrated and quantified business impact through the delivery of analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, or data-driven solutions
- Demonstrated technical fluency to partner effectively with data science, engineering, product, and technology teams on solution feasibility, design, and production-ready delivery
- Proven ability to translate complex and ambiguous business challenges into data, analytics, and AI-enabled roadmaps that drive efficiency, quality, outcomes, or financial performance
- Demonstrated solid leadership, communication, and execution skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, balance priorities, and deliver measurable outcomes

Preferred Qualifications:
- Certification or formal training in Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Product Management, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated knowledge of the U.S. healthcare industry, Risk Adjustment, or population health management
- Proven experience delivering AI, machine learning, automation, or advanced analytics solutions within complex, regulated environments

What We Offer:
- Opportunities for professional development
- Inclusive and supportive team culture
- Key benefits: Private health insurance, wellness programs, matching pension contribution, lunch provided by the company, training opportunities, employee donations matching and others
